gaps.sentence: Rarely ___ a debut film attracted such wide attention.
gaps.explanation: 'Rarely has a debut film attracted …' — perfect inversion.

gaps.sentence: Only when the results were published ___ the scale of the error become clear.
gaps.explanation: 'Only when … did the scale … become clear' — inverted past simple.

gaps.sentence: To such extremes ___ the fans go that the police were called in.
gaps.explanation: 'To such extremes did the fans go that …' — inverted past simple.

gaps.sentence: Not only ___ the bridge unsafe, but it was also far too narrow.
gaps.explanation: 'Not only was the bridge unsafe' — inverted past simple of be.

gaps.sentence: On no account ___ passengers open this door.
gaps.explanation: On no account should passengers… — formal prohibition.

gaps.sentence: ___ you require assistance, please do not hesitate to contact the desk.
gaps.explanation: 'Should you require …' = 'If you should require …' — formal inverted conditional.

gaps.sentence: ___ as it may sound, the machine still works perfectly.
gaps.explanation: Adjective + as + subject + verb = although it sounds strange.

gaps.sentence: So widespread ___ the outage that servers abroad noticed.
gaps.explanation: So widespread was the outage that… — inversion.
